items.item_text: Serving at UCLA Ronald Reagan Medical Center will give you the opportunity to use your specialized abilities to help improve the lives of our patients, their families, and your fellow team members. You’ll provide critical support that makes healing happen. We’d love to have you join us.

Supervisor oversees housekeeping functions for a multi-unit hospital, common areas up to 500,000 sq. feet. Responsible for daily supervision. Ensure housekeeping/maintenance standards of meeting and exceeding customer expectations are kept. Provide on-the-job training to staff, including proper use of chemicals and equipment, and ensure compliance with published safety standards.
Exhibits proficiency with all techniques and equipment used in department, i.e., floor machine, automatic floor scrubbers, vacuums, floor sanders to prepare wood floor for refinishing.
Provides effective decisions by clear and logical thinking.
Recognizes needs and suggests and/or makes recommendations for change to Superintendent.
Willingly seeks assistance from Superintendent in difficult situations.
Read and review articles and magazines related to the Environmental Services issues.
Maintains and has a positive and helpful attitude with patients, visitors, and staff.
Responds to and resolves complaints with a sense of urgency.
Works under constantly changing environment, sometimes under stressful conditions.
Adheres to Department and University Attendance Policy and Guidelines.
Must have a knowledge of effective cleaning techniques and routine preventive maintenance.
Ability to express ideas clearly, both orally and in writing.
Ability to plan, train and provide work direction to other in a manner that is conducive to full performance and high morale of the employee.
Ability to stand, bend, stoop, reach and climb stairs and ladders for long periods of times.
